done_when: Every review prompt carries the standards page (src/forge/standards.md), the same text the worker brief carries, as rules the reviewer checks the change against, and the review reports a change that breaks one of its rules as a finding that names the rule. A test runs a review through Forge's command and shows the page's text reaches the reviewer.

findings.body: Prototype fixes before sign-off use the light review path (`src/forge/close.py:80`), which passes `--max-priority P0` here. The new standards prompt requires a broken rule to be reported as a P1 `Standard:` finding (`src/forge/templates/review.md:154`). That P1 cannot pass the light review’s priority limit, so an API, data, or frontend standards violation in such a fix can still go unreported. The new command tests exercise only the default review path; `tests/test_aha_review.py:28-56` confirms the light path uses the P0 limit.
